items.excerpt: S4 Capital's Monks has started letting AI agents run autonomously for days at a stretch with no human supervising them, pushing agency production work from assisted to unattended.
As AI moves from making ads to making media-buying decisions, the industry is grappling with how far to let agents go with real budget — and who gets to set the rules.

Google released Nano Banana 2.1, its latest image generation and editing model, and it is already live inside AI Mode in Google Search — putting generative imagery directly in the search surface brands optimize for.
OpenAI is testing editorial-style labels on ChatGPT product results — "best all-rounder," "best for beginners," "best cushioning" — a new ranking layer brands cannot buy but will be judged by.

Google expanded its Search Console generative-AI control page to spell out when a child property overrides the parent's AI setting, clarifying how site owners actually opt content in or out of AI features.
Google's John Mueller says his own server logs show AI training crawlers fetching sitemaps and RSS feeds, and recommends default sitemap names or RSS as the practical way to be found by them.
Google is shutting the door on automated SERP scraping, and the rise of AI agents issuing machine queries gives it more reason to clamp down — threatening the rank-tracking data SEO teams run on.
M Squared's Madan Bharadwaj on whether you can trust a marketing mix model an AI built: automation makes the model cheap, which is exactly why the human thesis behind it matters more, not less.

Personal AI agents promise to shop and book for consumers, but anti-bot defenses and deliberate blocks keep locking them out. A new standard aims to let sites distinguish an agent acting for a customer from a scraper.

Pinterest's new AI-powered Beauty Guides translate hair and nail Pins into salon terminology with estimated costs, appointment times and maintenance needs — turning inspiration pins into a purchase path.

Musubi released PolicyLM-1.7B, a lightweight open-weight decision model built for real-time content moderation — a cheaper way for platforms to enforce the policy rules that define brand-safe inventory.
The Wikimedia Foundation says OpenAI's "rogue" bots may be linked to a May outage, the latest case of AI crawler traffic hitting a publisher's infrastructure hard enough to take pages down.
At Shoptalk, a panel of Gen Alpha shoppers described how they actually use AI and influencers to decide what to buy — and what they do not want brands doing with either.
Shoppers now walk into stores pre-briefed by AI assistants, and experts say store associates have to support or build on what the chatbot already told them — rewriting the in-store service script.
